The '''1953–54 Scottish Division A''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], who finished five points ahead of the second placed club [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. Celtic won their 20th league title with a match still to play, when they defeated [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] 3–0 at [[Easter Road]] on 17 April 1954. It was the club's first league championship win in 16 years. [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] and [[Hamilton Academical F.C.|Hamilton Academical]] finished 15th and 16th respectively and were relegated to the [[1954–55 Scottish Division B]].
